mentions.note: runner up in the club 10 mile walk championship the previous year

club 20 mile champion; retained National Police Champion title in the Barking-Southend Walk; first in the sealed handicap from scratch Belgrave member; National Police Champion — walked for the Police.
won 20 mile walk championship (R. W. Ricketts Shield), 2.47.49; holder; printed "F. Rickards" in the report text
holder for the three previous years; finished at 8 miles

one of "our members" successful outside the Club; 7th in the All England Police 10 mile championship (a championship, not a club) and in the winning team (team not named) Belgrave member; competed in a Police championship.
member of Belgrave's winning walking trio with Green and Bentley
